26.1.2.2612.0.7-alpha:
Alpha build of the Rust terrain path for Minecraft 26.1.

The solid and cutout layers of the world are meshed in Rust and drawn from the renderer's own section arena; Minecraft's own meshes for those two layers are skipped.
Animated textures are sampled from the game's block atlas, so fire, lava, water, campfires and lanterns move - Quality -> Fire animation switches that off.
Lava is shaped the way FluidRenderer shapes it: a source and the flowing half are two liquids, corners take the game's weighted average, a moving surface is a rotated quarter of the flowing sprite, and a step's riser is drawn only where it is exposed.
Lighting, fog and the lightmap are the game's own (sample_lightmap and the Fog UBO), and entity shadows line up with the ground they fall on.

Full notes: https://github.com/NTS-Official/wgpu-mc-neo/blob/master/neoforge/README.md
